claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
gold_evidence: NASA astronauts confirm the wall is invisible to the naked human eye from low Earth orbit.

claim: Earth revolves around the Sun in approximately 365.25 days.
gold_evidence: The Earth takes approximately 365.256 days to complete one orbit around the Sun.

claim: Albert Einstein won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on the photoelectric effect.
gold_evidence: The 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Albert Einstein for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect.

claim: The Roman Colosseum was built entirely out of reinforced modern concrete in 1950.
gold_evidence: Construction of the Colosseum began under the emperor Vespasian in 72 AD and was completed in 80 AD under Titus.

claim: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level on Earth.
gold_evidence: Mount Everest's peak is the highest altitude above mean sea level at 8,848.86 meters.

claim: The Eiffel Tower was originally constructed in Madrid before being moved to Paris.
gold_evidence: The Eiffel Tower was constructed from 1887 to 1889 in Paris on the Champ de Mars.

claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
gold_evidence: At 1 standard atmosphere (101.325 kPa), the boiling point of pure water is 100 °C.

claim: Humans have landed on the surface of Mars and established permanent colonies.
gold_evidence: No crewed missions to Mars have yet taken place; only robotic orbiters, landers, and rovers have explored Mars.

claim: The Mona Lisa was painted by the Italian Renaissance artist Leonardo da Vinci.
gold_evidence: The Mona Lisa is a portrait painting by Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci, likely started in 1503.

claim: There are secret underground alien civilizations residing inside the core of the Moon.
gold_evidence: Lunar seismology and gravitational mapping show no hollow chambers or evidence of subterranean lunar civilizations.

claim: DNA stands for Deoxyribonucleic acid.
gold_evidence: Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) is a molecule composed of two polynucleotide chains that coil around each other.

claim: The Titanic sank in the Atlantic Ocean in April 1912 after colliding with an iceberg.
gold_evidence: The RMS Titanic sank on the morning of 15 April 1912 in the North Atlantic Ocean after hitting an iceberg.

claim: Penicillin was discovered by Scottish physician Alexander Fleming in 1928.
gold_evidence: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in September 1928 at St Mary's Hospital, London.

claim: The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.
gold_evidence: The speed of light in vacuum, denoted c, is exactly 299,792,458 metres per second.

claim: The Pacific Ocean is the smallest ocean on Earth.
gold_evidence: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions.

claim: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
gold_evidence: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and the largest in the Solar System, with a mass more than two and a half times all other planets combined.

claim: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
gold_evidence: Lightning can strike the same place repeatedly; tall structures like the Empire State Building are struck dozens of times per year.

claim: The chemical symbol for Gold on the periodic table is Au.
gold_evidence: Gold is a chemical element with the symbol Au (from Latin aurum) and atomic number 79.

claim: Bananas grow on trees with woody trunks.
gold_evidence: The banana plant is a large herbaceous plant, not a tree, and has a pseudostem made of leaf sheath bases rather than woody bark.

claim: The United Nations was established in 1945 following the end of World War II.
gold_evidence: The United Nations was established on 24 October 1945 upon ratification of the UN Charter by the five permanent members.

claim: Sharks are mammals that nurse their young with milk.
gold_evidence: Sharks are elasmobranch fish with cartilaginous skeletons and gills, not mammals.

claim: Venus is the second planet from the Sun.
gold_evidence: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, orbiting it every 224.7 Earth days.

claim: The Amazon River flows into the Pacific Ocean.
gold_evidence: The Amazon River empties into the Atlantic Ocean on the northeastern coast of Brazil.

claim: Oxygen makes up about 21 percent of Earth's atmosphere by volume.
gold_evidence: By volume, dry air contains 78.08% nitrogen, 20.95% oxygen, 0.93% argon, and 0.04% carbon dioxide.

claim: Penguins are native only to the Arctic Circle in the Northern Hemisphere.
gold_evidence: Penguins live almost exclusively in the Southern Hemisphere, primarily in Antarctica.

claim: The Declaration of Independence of the United States was adopted in 1776.
gold_evidence: The Declaration of Independence was adopted by the Second Continental Congress on July 4, 1776.

claim: Humans use only ten percent of their brains in their lifetime.
gold_evidence: Neuroimaging proves that almost all regions of the brain are active and functional during daily tasks.

claim: The Sun is classified as a yellow dwarf main-sequence star.
gold_evidence: The Sun is a G-type main-sequence star (G2V), colloquially known as a yellow dwarf.

claim: Australia is both a sovereign country and the smallest continental landmass.
gold_evidence: Australia is the world's sixth-largest country by total area and the smallest recognized continent.

claim: The Apollo 11 mission landed humans on the Moon in July 1969.
gold_evidence: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Apollo 11 Lunar Module on the Moon on July 20, 1969.

claim: Diamonds are formed from compressed organic biological coal deposits.
gold_evidence: Geological evidence shows natural diamonds formed in Earth's mantle billions of years before land plants and coal existed.

claim: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
gold_evidence: Tokyo is the capital and most populous prefecture of Japan.

claim: Sound travels faster in air than in water.
gold_evidence: Sound travels at about 343 m/s in air and 1,480 m/s in liquid water due to higher density and elasticity.

claim: Photosynthesis produces oxygen and glucose using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.
gold_evidence: Photosynthesis converts carbon dioxide and water into oxygen and energy-rich organic carbohydrates like glucose.

claim: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
gold_evidence: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, spanning over 9 million square kilometers.

claim: Napoleon Bonaparte was exceptionally short compared to average French men of his era.
gold_evidence: Napoleon stood about 5 feet 6 inches (168 cm) tall, which was slightly above average for French males of the early 19th century.

claim: The human skeleton typically has 206 bones in an adult body.
gold_evidence: The adult human skeletal system consists of 206 individual bones.

claim: The planet Mars has two small moons named Phobos and Deimos.
gold_evidence: Mars has two small natural satellites, Phobos and Deimos, discovered in 1877 by Asaph Hall.

claim: Goldfish have a memory span of only three seconds.
gold_evidence: Behavioral studies demonstrate goldfish retain learned behaviors and spatial memory for months.

claim: The Brooklyn Bridge connects Manhattan and Brooklyn in New York City.
gold_evidence: The Brooklyn Bridge is a hybrid cable-stayed/suspension bridge spanning the East River between Manhattan and Brooklyn.

claim: Chameleons change color exclusively to blend in with their background environment.
gold_evidence: Chameleons change skin color primarily for social signaling, aggression, courtship, and thermoregulation.

claim: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded annually in Oslo, Norway.
gold_evidence: According to Alfred Nobel's will, the Nobel Peace Prize is selected and presented in Oslo, Norway.

claim: The Earth is perfectly flat and surrounded by an impenetrable Antarctic ice dome.
gold_evidence: Geodesy, astronomical observations, and space photography confirm the Earth is an oblate spheroid.

claim: The ozone layer absorbs most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.
gold_evidence: Earth's stratospheric ozone layer absorbs 97 to 99 percent of the Sun's medium-frequency ultraviolet light (UVB).

claim: Bats are completely blind and navigate without any optical vision.
gold_evidence: All bat species have functional eyes and eyesight; microbats also utilize echolocation for nocturnal obstacle navigation.

claim: The Mariana Trench is the deepest known oceanic trench on Earth.
gold_evidence: The Mariana Trench contains the Challenger Deep, reaching an approximate maximum depth of 10,994 meters.

claim: Coffee beans are the seeds of berries produced by the Coffea plant.
gold_evidence: Coffee beans are the seeds found inside the cherries or berries of the Coffea shrub.

claim: The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic Ocean with the Indian Ocean.
gold_evidence: The Panama Canal cuts across the Isthmus of Panama, connecting the Atlantic Ocean with the Pacific Ocean.

claim: Bulls are enraged specifically by the red color of a matador's cape.
gold_evidence: Cattle are dichromatic and cannot distinguish red; bulls react to the threatening movement of the cape cloth.

claim: Alexander the Great was a king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon.
gold_evidence: Alexander III of Macedon, known as Alexander the Great, was king of Macedon from 336 BC until 323 BC.

claim: Spiders are classified as eight-legged arachnids, not insects.
gold_evidence: Spiders belong to the class Arachnida, distinguished from insects by having eight legs and two body tagmata.

claim: The Berlin Wall was demolished in November 1989.
gold_evidence: The fall of the Berlin Wall occurred on the evening of 9 November 1989.

claim: Ostriches bury their heads in the sand when they sense predators.
gold_evidence: Ostriches lay flat on the ground with their necks outstretched to avoid detection; they do not bury their heads in sand.

claim: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun in our solar system.
gold_evidence: Mercury is the smallest and innermost planet in the Solar System.

claim: Vaccines introduce microchips designed to wirelessly control neurological decisions.
gold_evidence: Biological and pharmaceutical analyses confirm vaccines consist of biological antigen or mRNA lipid formulations with no electronic components.

claim: The Amazon rainforest covers over five million square kilometers across South America.
gold_evidence: The Amazon basin encompasses roughly 7 million square kilometers, of which 5.5 million square kilometers is dense rainforest.

claim: Thomas Edison invented the first automobile in history.
gold_evidence: Karl Benz is recognized as the inventor of the modern motorcar, patenting the Benz Patent-Motorwagen in 1886.

claim: Saturn has prominent planetary rings composed predominantly of water ice and rock dust.
gold_evidence: Saturn's ring system is composed of 99% pure water ice particles ranging from micrometers to meters in size.

claim: Cracking knuckles causes chronic arthritis in finger joints.
gold_evidence: Controlled epidemiological studies show no correlation between habitual knuckle cracking and the development of osteoarthritis.

claim: The periodic table was organized systematically by Russian chemist Dmitri Mendeleev.
gold_evidence: Dmitri Mendeleev published the first widely recognized periodic table in 1869, ordering elements by atomic mass.

claim: CRISPR-Cas9 acts as an RNA-guided endonuclease that cleaves double-stranded DNA.
gold_evidence: CRISPR-associated Cas9 protein uses dual-RNA or single-guide RNA to introduce site-specific double-strand breaks in DNA.

claim: Telomerase reverse transcriptase expression is upregulated in the majority of human cancer cells.
gold_evidence: Approximately 85% to 90% of human malignant tumors express active telomerase to achieve cellular immortality.

claim: Hydroxychloroquine significantly reduces 28-day mortality in hospitalized patients with severe COVID-19.
gold_evidence: The RECOVERY randomized controlled trial showed hydroxychloroquine did not reduce 28-day mortality among hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

claim: Metformin inhibits hepatic gluconeogenesis primarily through mitochondrial respiratory complex I inhibition.
gold_evidence: Metformin suppresses hepatic glucose output by inhibiting mitochondrial complex I and activating AMPK pathway signaling.

claim: Antibiotics effectively eradicate viral respiratory infections such as influenza and rhinoviruses.
gold_evidence: Antibacterial medications selectively target bacterial cell wall synthesis or ribosomes and have zero efficacy against viral pathogens.

claim: Statins lower low-density lipoprotein cholesterol by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase.
gold_evidence: Statins competitively inhibit 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme in cholesterol synthesis.

claim: Vitamin D supplementation guarantees total immunity against acute respiratory viral infections.
gold_evidence: Clinical trials indicate vitamin D provides modest immunomodulatory support but does not guarantee protection or immunity against respiratory infection.

claim: BRCA1 mutations increase the lifetime risk of developing breast and ovarian cancers.
gold_evidence: Inherited pathogenic variants in the BRCA1 tumor suppressor gene confer up to a 72% lifetime risk of breast cancer.

claim: Graphene consists of a single two-dimensional monolayer of sp2-hybridized carbon atoms arranged in a honeycomb lattice.
gold_evidence: Graphene is a single atomic layer of carbon atoms tightly bound in a hexagonal honeycomb crystal lattice.

claim: Ivermectin monotherapy eliminates viral replication in randomized clinical trials of ambulatory patients.
gold_evidence: Multiple large-scale double-blind randomized trials (ACTIV-6, PRINCIPLE, TOGETHER) demonstrated ivermectin does not improve recovery time or viral clearance.

claim: Insulin signaling stimulates GLUT4 translocation to the plasma membrane in skeletal muscle cells.
gold_evidence: Binding of insulin to its receptor triggers PI3K/Akt phosphorylation leading to GLUT4 vesicle translocation to the cell surface.

claim: Homeopathic dilutions exceeding 30C retain pharmacologically active chemical molecules of the starting solute.
gold_evidence: A 30C dilution represents a 10^-60 dilution factor, exceeding Avogadro's constant; statistically zero solute molecules remain in the solvent.

claim: Aspirin irreversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase-1 and cyclooxygenase-2 via serine acetylation.
gold_evidence: Acetylsalicylic acid covalently modifies and inactivates COX enzymes by transferring an acetyl group to Ser529 in COX-1.

claim: Helicobacter pylori colonization of the stomach lining is a major etiological cause of peptic ulcers.
gold_evidence: Warren and Marshall proved that H. pylori infection induces chronic gastritis and accounts for over 80% of duodenal ulcers.

claim: Mitochondria contain their own circular genome distinct from nuclear DNA.
gold_evidence: Human mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) is a double-stranded circular molecule of 16,569 base pairs encoding 37 genes.

claim: Interferon-gamma promotes macrophage activation and classical M1 proinflammatory polarization.
gold_evidence: IFN-gamma synergizes with TLR agonists to induce M1 macrophage phenotypes characterized by inducible nitric oxide synthase.

claim: Tumor necrosis factor alpha receptor blockade exacerbates active rheumatoid arthritis symptoms.
gold_evidence: Anti-TNF biologics (infliximab, etanercept, adalimumab) significantly suppress joint inflammation and reduce disease activity in rheumatoid arthritis.

claim: Ribosomes are responsible for biological protein synthesis by translating messenger RNA.
gold_evidence: Ribosomes read mRNA codons and catalyze peptide bond formation linking aminoacyl-tRNAs into nascent polypeptide chains.

claim: Prions are infectious pathogens that contain nucleic acid genetic material like viruses.
gold_evidence: Prions are proteinaceous infectious particles devoid of detectable DNA or RNA, propagating by inducing conformational templating of normal PrP.

claim: Glutamate is the primary excitatory neurotransmitter in the mammalian central nervous system.
gold_evidence: L-glutamate acts as the principal fast excitatory transmitter at AMPA, NMDA, and kainate receptors throughout the brain.

claim: GABA receptor activation typically causes hyperpolarization of the neuronal membrane.
gold_evidence: GABAA receptors are ligand-gated chloride channels; chloride influx upon GABA binding hyperpolarizes the postsynaptic membrane potential.

claim: Platelet aggregation in primary hemostasis is mediated by von Willebrand factor and fibrinogen.
gold_evidence: Platelet adhesion requires vWF binding to GPIb-IX-V, followed by platelet-platelet crosslinking through fibrinogen bridging of GPIIb/IIIa.

claim: Human red blood cells contain active nuclear genomic replication machinery.
gold_evidence: Mature human erythrocytes enucleate during erythropoiesis and lack nuclei, DNA, and transcription apparatus.

claim: B cells undergo somatic hypermutation in germinal centers to increase antibody affinity.
gold_evidence: Activation-induced cytidine deaminase (AID) introduces nucleotide substitutions in immunoglobulin variable regions during germinal center reaction.

claim: Monoclonal antibodies targeting PD-1 or PD-L1 stimulate antitumor immune responses by releasing T-cell inhibition.
gold_evidence: Checkpoint inhibitors blocking PD-1/PD-L1 interaction restore cytotoxic T lymphocyte effector function and induce clinical antitumor regression.

claim: Cellular apoptosis is characterized by uncontrolled membrane rupture and systemic inflammatory leakage.
gold_evidence: Apoptosis is programmed cell death involving cell shrinkage, chromatin condensation, and phagocytosis without plasma membrane rupture or inflammation; necrosis involves lysis.

claim: PCR uses Taq DNA polymerase because the enzyme withstands repeated high-temperature denaturation steps.
gold_evidence: Thermus aquaticus (Taq) DNA polymerase is thermostable at 95 degrees C, enabling automated thermal cycling without adding enzyme each round.

claim: ATP synthase generates adenosine triphosphate using an electrochemical proton gradient across membranes.
gold_evidence: F1FO ATP synthase harnesses proton motive force across the inner mitochondrial membrane to catalyze ATP synthesis from ADP and inorganic phosphate.

claim: Stem cells possess the capacity for both self-renewal and multilineage differentiation.
gold_evidence: Pluripotent and adult stem cells can divide symmetrically/asymmetrically to maintain the stem cell pool and differentiate into specialized cell types.

claim: SARS-CoV-2 viral entry into host cells is mediated by spike protein binding to the ACE2 receptor.
gold_evidence: Structural biology confirms SARS-CoV-2 spike receptor-binding domain binds angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) with nanomolar affinity.

claim: Dietary fat intake has been conclusively proven to be the sole causative mechanism of all human cardiovascular diseases.
gold_evidence: Conflicting meta-analyses indicate cardiovascular disease etiology involves multifactorial genetics, inflammation, insulin resistance, and lifestyle; saturated fats exhibit variable risk profiles.

claim: Antioxidant megadose supplementation reliably prevents cancer mortality in clinical populations.
gold_evidence: Large randomized clinical trials (CARET, ATBC) demonstrated that high-dose beta-carotene supplementation actually increased lung cancer incidence and mortality.

claim: Hemoglobin binds four oxygen molecules cooperatively via allosteric transitions between T and R states.
gold_evidence: Oxygenation of hemoglobin exhibits sigmoidal binding kinetics as binding to one heme increases affinity in neighboring subunits.

claim: Telomere length shortens progressively with somatic cell divisions in the absence of telomerase.
gold_evidence: The end-replication problem of linear DNA synthesis leads to progressive loss of 50-200 base pairs of telomeric hexanucleotide repeats per mitosis.

claim: Excessive intake of refined sugar causes diabetes exclusively through acute pancreatic tissue destruction.
gold_evidence: Type 2 diabetes pathogenesis is characterized by progressive peripheral insulin resistance and beta-cell secretory exhaustion, not physical pancreatic destruction.

claim: Synaptic plasticity via long-term potentiation involves NMDA receptor activation and AMPA receptor insertion.
gold_evidence: LTP induction requires NMDA channel opening by depolarization, allowing calcium influx that recruits additional AMPA receptors to the postsynaptic density.

claim: Low-dose aspirin universally reduces total stroke risk without increasing gastrointestinal bleeding.
gold_evidence: Aspirin reduces ischemic stroke risk but significantly increases intracranial and gastrointestinal hemorrhage rates.

claim: The gut microbiome composition correlates with metabolic health, immune modulation, and central nervous system signaling.
gold_evidence: Commensal intestinal microbiota generate short-chain fatty acids, modulate enteric immune cells, and communicate through the gut-brain axis.

claim: Human longevity can be extended indefinitely using commercial cellular telomere-elongation creams.
gold_evidence: There is no credible peer-reviewed clinical evidence that topical consumer telomere creams alter biological lifespan in humans.

claim: Artificial sweetener consumption produces identical glycemic spikes as pure sucrose in humans.
gold_evidence: Non-nutritive sweeteners (aspartame, sucralose, stevia) do not contain carbohydrates and do not acutely stimulate insulin or raise blood glucose like sucrose.
